name: Iaşi International Airport
before:
The most important airport in the Romanian region of Moldavia and third busiest in the country, 8 km east of central Iași.

The terminal split is the thing to get right. Passenger flights use two buildings: T4 handles all domestic and Schengen flights, and T3 handles non-Schengen. The older T1 is now offices and storage, and there are plans to turn the former T2 into a cargo terminal.

Getting into the city is cheap and simple. CTP route 50 runs non-stop to Union Square and the railway station every 30 minutes, taking about 20 minutes, for 4 lei as of December 2025.

The airport is close enough to the border to be a practical arrival from the Republic of Moldova by road.

It is one of the oldest accredited airports in Romania. Scheduled flights on the Bucharest to Galați to Iași to Chișinău route began on 24 June 1926.
after:
The airport for Iași, and Romania's third busiest.

CTP city bus route 50 serves the airport. A standard city ticket costs 4 lei and is valid for 120 minutes on any route.
